svg.text: both arrows were added by ①
the end m of a becomes the start of b
just after making a and b separately
arrows that pointed at right now point at left
body and out are new states. 4 ε are added

of ④'s four, only the “skip” is here
Dark box: a new state. Yellow box: a new element. Dashed: transitions from the sub-pattern. Circles carry the code's variable names
